entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • EE: Locals should list an in-scope local that has the same name as a parameter (F#) #86280

Closed

  • Unions: no nullable warning when a `null` conditional branch is converted to a union with non-nullable case types #86225
    18.14
  • Speculative binding throws KeyNotFoundException for a task-returning local function named Main in top-level statements #86103
    18.13
  • NullableWalker returns pooled `Variables` collections twice when lambda analysis throws, corrupting nullable analysis process-wide #86276
    18.14
  • Syntax node actions for partial constructors are not called for the defining part #86086
    18.13

PullRequests

Created

  • Find and remove unnecessary Razor using directives for dotnet format #86283
    Community, Needs API Review, Area-Razor

Merged

  • Flesh out impact of reportTopLevelWarnings and reportRemainingWarnings parameters for NullableWalker.VisitUnionConversion #86270
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions, Next
  • Don't report CA1704 for EventArgs parameters named e #85161
    Community, Next
  • Restore non-draft main insertion PRs #86284
    Next
  • Update insiders insertion target #86285
  • Avoid reporting WRN_MainIgnored when in semantic model binder code #86245
    Area-Compilers, Next

    Area-Compilers, Community, Next

    Area-Compilers, Next

    Area-Infrastructure, Feature - Run File
  • Add a fixall in document LSP code action #86229
    VSCode

    VSCode
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3124317 #86117

  • Rank and highlight F# Navigate To results like C# and VB #85280
    VSCode
